scope: Two additional Helios convoy hulls and six faction-selected Span/Wasp body variants
authority: Owner requests every first-sector hull and actual model construction. Canon tone: docs/worldbuilding/vibe/vibe-CANONICAL.md. Manufacturing details below are ART EXTRAPOLATION, not narrative canon.

independentVisualAcceptance.reviewer: /root graphics controller; independent of model author
independentVisualAcceptance.scope: All twelve exact candidate GLBs below: whole-asset construction and optical appearance under the current shared game lighting, post and faction pigments. Includes preserved hull/drive/cabin zones and the rebuilt component zones. Source promotion, release publication and live performance validation remain controller-owned.
independentVisualAcceptance.reviewDecision: Mule and Atlas plus their finished external LODs accepted; DMC Span, Reach Span and Free Militia Wasp retained their accepted hashes. Final MTS Span, MTS Wasp and SCN Wasp revisions explicitly accepted after current-rig review. Geometry authoring closed; no additional model changes requested.

identity: Use original, hash-pinned source GLBs. Preserve all hull footprints, attachment sockets and transforms, collision meshes, native LODs, existing coatings/maps, warning marks, and useful machinery. New construction stays within existing bounds. Candidate exports only.

zones.zone: main tapered hull, raised forward cab and glazing, propulsion collars, side freight stacks, railings and underframe
zones.review: Original chase views and separated manufactured-component bounds show a useful squat carrier identity, upper working rail and paired cargo stacks. Keep the existing cab, engines, hull chines, cargo volume, lashings, markings and mechanical substructure.

zones.fictionDevelopmentAgreement: ART EXTRAPOLATION: a small freight carrier's maintenance channel gives access to a paired longitudinal traction power bus. It is protected by the retained deck rail and two formed bridge saddles.
zones.materialBill: Original coated metal roof is physically opened; oxidized load deck sits below machined nickel coaming. Existing ceramic substrate insulates two longitudinal bus housings. Lacquered folded bridge saddles transfer loads to the untouched roof shoulders. Wide dark gaps and polished edge glints establish the construction; no black decal holes, grille stickers or detached machinery.
zones.lod: Keep opening and saddle silhouette at all LODs; remove coupling bands and extra joints at LOD1/2. At distance reuse and join existing material roles.

zones.fictionDevelopmentAgreement: ART EXTRAPOLATION: sealed load canisters use protected lifting bridges below their top faces so handling rigging cannot snag adjacent crates.
zones.materialBill: Cut through original lid to a shallow octagonal pocket, retained enamel exterior, dark liner, one transverse forged lifting bridge and narrow bare coaming. The load path ends inside the original crate walls. No radiator fins on cargo.
zones.lod: Four simple negative spaces and lifting bars remain; perimeter bevel segments and mounting shoes disappear at distance.

zones.zone: long pressure hull, prow, forward command cab, stacked cargo, engine cluster and rails
zones.review: Original chase view shows a sound long heavy-hauler silhouette and coherent cargo mass, but the large dorsal roof aft of the working load zone is blank. Keep ship length, tapered shoulders, raised bridge, cargo stacks, engines, source color and graphics.

zones.fictionDevelopmentAgreement: ART EXTRAPOLATION: heavy freight tractor pressure accumulators and drive-transfer plant occupy a recessed servicing saddle ahead of the rear engine cluster.
zones.materialBill: Physically open the existing aft roof. Two pressure casings sit on a dark floor inside an actual nickel-lined reveal. Formed transverse channel braces and paired diagonal knees transfer force into the retained hull shoulders. Existing pale enamel body surrounds a dark machine bay with restrained sea-lacquer cowl plates. Never remove the pressure hull or leave floating engine hardware.
zones.lod: Broad well, casings and braces survive; small straps and attachment shoes are close-range only. LOD1/2 batch into existing hull/mechanical/ceramic roles.

zones.fictionDevelopmentAgreement: ART EXTRAPOLATION: reinforced recessed lifting cradles service the tall freight stacks.
zones.materialBill: Actual recessed lid pocket with a short inset lifting bridge, dark floor and narrow exposed rim. Original crate proportions, side locks and warning marking stay intact.
zones.lod: Simplify to coaming, negative space and one lifting bridge; no small fasteners at far LOD.

zones.fictionDevelopmentAgreement: Same cargo servicing mechanism as accepted original Span, applied to each existing faction body.
zones.materialBill: Six cut cargo service wells, folded broad access leaves, recessed dark machinery floor and machined rims. Preserve every original faction livery, emblem, hull texture and attachment; added finish uses the existing role palette at distant LOD.
zones.lod: Use the accepted Span's 0/1/2 detail policy within each native LOD group.

zones.fictionDevelopmentAgreement: Same heat-exchanger construction as accepted Wasp, fitted to each faction body.
zones.materialBill: Paired real nacelle-root openings with folded heat shutters and narrow nickel lips. Original wing/armor silhouette, glazing, faction markings and native coating remain authoritative.
zones.lod: Use the accepted Wasp's 0/1/2 detail policy within each native LOD group.

zones.zone: three pressure lids, central gold-zone bridge, repeated parting screws, light strip and mark placement
zones.fictionDevelopmentAgreement: ART EXTRAPOLATION: protected sealed freight travels beneath three stepped pressure covers around a recessed longitudinal boarding/service passage. One bridge controls pressure locks; fitted saddles root the covers in the cargo body.
zones.shapeFailure: Three overlapping flat slabs conceal the cargo construction and leave only a large pale lid.
zones.materialBill: Retain actual faction Hull paint and maps. Rebuild formed sloping shoulders and tapered ends, physically cut the passage, inset a dark walking floor and grounded cover saddles. Six gasketed pressure-latch doors and a glazed bridge replace the now-hidden base cargo wells. Retain luminous faction markings, seated on adjacent real roof rather than floating over the channel. Original lids already use Hull, so no misleading Mechanical-to-paint retag is needed.
zones.lod: The native distant base LODs previously omitted the entire faction lid kit. Preserve the new broad cover/channel silhouette there with simplified formed shells and no latch handles or tiny fittings; join into existing role groups.

zones.zone: three dorsal clamshells, raised gold-zone, blisters, light strip and faction mark
zones.fictionDevelopmentAgreement: ART EXTRAPOLATION: three pressure-sealed avionics cases are installed on fitted dark skirts beneath a protected optical command spine. Circular pressure/radar fittings seat on the case shoulders.
zones.shapeFailure: Blank rectangular blocks with a floating upper strip and mechanical blisters; no convincing attachment or access.
zones.materialBill: Existing Hull paint forms canted shoulders, stepped heels and tapered noses; dark gaskets and rooted clamps make each case attachment explicit. Actual recessed optical/service doors with thin nickel lips. A continuous supported command lantern connects the formerly suspended upper strip and mark to the case. Keep source wing/drive/root heat exchangers and each faction material/marker identity.
zones.lod: Source has LOD0 only. Batch all static fixtures by original role; no new tiny fastener pattern.

zones.zone: three spine plates, flank plates, transverse strip and luminous perimeter
zones.fictionDevelopmentAgreement: ART EXTRAPOLATION: separate patrol sensor cases fit into a protected optical rack; a formed transverse armor yoke carries the rack to the wing roots.
zones.shapeFailure: Stacked flat strips look pasted onto the base hull, with suspended luminous lines.
zones.materialBill: Canted lacquered instrument housings with real inset optical/service apertures sit on oxidized fitted skirts. Bend the cross strip into a descending formed yoke and rooted flank saddles. A dark protective perimeter rail and visible case bearings physically support the retained luminous SCN lines. Preserve actual source painted Hull role and faction markers.
zones.lod: Source has LOD0 only. Join repeated fittings into existing role groups; preserve broad sensor/yoke construction, not incidental fasteners.

zones.zone: all remaining hull, canopy, drive, hardpoint and faction identity surfaces
zones.review: Retain original variant material groups/maps and useful non-hull fixtures. The three specifically billed kits above supersede the original flat fixtures, with light strips reseated onto their real supports. No faction file is replaced with the base model.
No cabin seats or invisible detail is added.

techniqueLedger.negativeSpace: Boolean source shells after isolating authored islands, rejoined after surgery
techniqueLedger.construction: Lofted coaming and folded saddle sections; actual cargo lifting recesses
techniqueLedger.materials: Original maps retained; explicit dielectric lacquer, ceramic and machined nickel scalar substances
techniqueLedger.optimization: One exported group per static material/LOD, far detail substitution by construction

evidence: Original source hashes remain pinned in additional_fleet_sources.json; the twelve accepted candidate hashes are recorded above. promotion.json holds exact paths, per-LOD raw triangles/draws and socket/bounds comparisons.
